body.text: If you were signed out but the server still had your account cookie (say, you signed out without reloading, or your session expired), the pull request page kept showing Close, Rebase & merge, Approve CI and Delete branch. Clicking them couldn't work. Now the page treats you as having no access whenever you're not signed in, so those buttons stay hidden. The comment sidebar shows the sign-up prompt instead of a disabled comment box, and the prompt shrinks to fit the narrow sidebar. | | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | Signed out, with a stale cookie | | | This is the first of four stacked pull requests for the pull request page: 1. #4812 hide pull actions from signed-out viewers (this one) 2. #4813 markdown editor and comment form 3. #4814 keep the scroll position when switching versions 4. #4815 pull actions next to the title, with a sticky bar Merge them in order. Each one also contains the commits of the ones before it, until those are merged.

title.text: web/pulls: hide pull actions from signed-out viewers
